input: one exact user or assistant turn content string; no question or benchmark labels

newline_policy.line_ending: LF newline belongs to the block before it
newline_policy.blank_lines: whitespace-only blocks join the preceding text block; leading whitespace-only blocks join the following text block

sentence_policy.boundary_condition: terminator followed by whitespace or end-of-block
sentence_policy.ordered_list_marker: a period directly after a line-leading digit sequence, optionally preceded by spaces or tabs, and followed by whitespace is not a sentence boundary
sentence_policy.abbreviations: no abbreviation lexicon; e.g. Dr. Smith splits after Dr.
sentence_policy.unicode_punctuation: preserved; only ASCII period, question mark, and exclamation mark are sentence terminators
sentence_policy.decimal_points: not a boundary when the next character is not whitespace

preservation.required_reconstruction: concatenate span content in span-index order and compare exactly to source turn content
preservation.offset_convention: zero-based Python Unicode code-point offsets; half-open [char_start, char_end)

empty_content.whitespace_only_nonempty_turn: one or more exact non-empty spans; whitespace is not discarded
